Method of Attack: Using a one-way cryptographic hash with a predictable salt making it vulnerable to dictionary attacks
Password hash with insufficient computational effort allowing brute force of user passwords leading to unauthorized access
Fixed the vulnerability by using PBKDF2-SHA256 with a randomly generated salt
Impacted Systems: SanDisk USB flash drives using SanDisk SecureAccess software
SanDisk USB flash drives using SanDisk PrivateAccess software
Attack Vector: Brute force attack on SecureAccess passwords
Software update to fix previous brute force vulnerability
